checks: Projection of a bounded estimator onto a band containing the target contracts pointwise error on the coverage event; off-event squared error <=4M^2, yielding risk r_n+4M^2 delta_n without estimator/band independence.
New radius max(C-L,U-C)<=U-L covers the old interval. Choosing failure n^-2 is essential to preserve the integrated rate; fixed failure probability would leave a constant risk term.

Armwise cell conditional means are arbitrary weighted averages of t-Holder responses and stay within L d^(t/2) h^t. Overlap/density control counts. Separate risk and band grids h_E~n^-1/(2t+d) and h_B~(log n/n)^1/(2t+d) yield the stated diagonal-class rates and projection unites their centers.
